mission: Carry the survey mission from intuition into evidence. Two worlds show the same unknown marks, and Ben's private sense of wrongness starts becoming a track he can follow.
chapter_turn: The disturbance stops being something only Ben feels and becomes something the ship can chart. Ben starts withholding in small, deliberate ways.

pressure_ladder.label: hook
pressure_ladder.note: Use hyperspace routine and instrument drift to show Ben and Desh as an established team before the first world appears.

pressure_ladder.label: reveal
pressure_ladder.note: At the first world, give Ben one physical spike of wrongness and let him choose to leave it out of the report.

pressure_ladder.label: escalation
pressure_ladder.note: At the second world, repeat the marks, let Desh draw the line, and end with the survey becoming pursuit.

next_scene_obligations.note: The Failing Seal — Race Against Veraine: Main dramatic throughline. The wound in the Force is real, the seal is failing, and Veraine is racing to exploit the crisis. Carries the central dramatic question: can Ben succeed where the Jedi Lords failed?

The Institutional Reckoning — GAG Shadow, Reformations Cover-Up, and Veraine as the Mirror: Main plot complication + thematic pressure + Jacen parallel reinforcement. Merged per D5 — Veraine's institutional antagonism is the Order's internal politics expressed through one character, and Ben/Desh's GAG shadow is the personal register of the same question. The merged subplot carries (a) Ben and Desh's shared GAG history surfacing and being acknowledged, (b) Ben's discovery and metabolization of the Reformations' true purpose, (c) his agonizing decision to withhold from Luke under crisis conditions, (d) Veraine's parallel institutional exploitation as the mirror against which his choice is tested, and (e) his final choice to tell the Order. All five strands converge on Ch 28 s2 — the office scene pays off the thread that has been running through Veraine's ledger, Ben's silences, and Desh's steady presence all along.

Ben/Desh: operational partnership — survey team, Ch1 baseline → co-investigators — Desh's instruments validate what Ben's Force-sense has been telling him; the partnership shifts from favor-to-a-friend toward shared reading of the same problem

Ben/Luke: private alliance — Luke entrusted the investigation → first withholding — Ben files the report and leaves the Force impression out. The withholding is small enough that neither father nor son would name it

exit_vector.summary: The Steady Returns in hyperspace, pointed at uncharted coordinates. The wrongness, now anchored to a bearing, has teeth. Ben closes the chapter knowing the survey route was the corridor he was already following.
